candidates.source_title: Russia Showed India’s Flag in Space! 🇮🇳🇷🇺 #independenceday #shorts
candidates.source_description:
From a 5 km long Tiranga Yatra in Haryana to the International Space Station 400 km above Earth, India’s National Flag shines everywhere this Independence Day! 🇮🇳✨
Russian Cosmonauts aboard the ISS sent a powerful message of friendship to India, celebrating 79 years of unbreakable Indo-Russian diplomatic ties. From launching Aryabhata in 1975 to Rakesh Sharma’s historic spaceflight in 1984, India and Russia share a timeless bond.
What are your thoughts on this legendary friendship?

candidates.source_title: Russian Astronauts Wave Indian Flag In Space For 80th Independence Day! 🇮🇳
candidates.source_description:
While we are preparing to hoist the Tiranga on ground for India's 80th Independence Day, Russian astronauts aboard the International Space Station surprised us all!

Holding our Indian flag high in space, they sent a special video message wishing 1.4 billion Indians a Happy 80th Independence Day.

This gesture is a reminder of the strong, 79-year-old friendship between India and Russia.
